description:
About the Studentship

The University of East Anglia (UEA) invites applications for a fully funded PhD opportunity in Psychology at the School of Psychology in Norwich, United Kingdom. The programme is research-focused and welcomes projects aligned with the School's expertise. University of East Anglia invites applications for a PhD position in this area: Psychology at University of East Anglia 2027. The work sits within Psychology, Neuroscience, Medical Science. The role is based in Norwich, United Kingdom. Full funding is provided; financial support is listed as GBP 21,805 per year (2026/27 rate). Applications close 14 January 2027.

Research Areas

  • Cognitive Neuroscience
  • Cognitive Psychology
  • Developmental Science
  • Social Psychology
  • Related interdisciplinary areas within the School of Psychology

Research Environment

UEA highlights strong research infrastructure, including behavioural and neuroimaging laboratories and the Developmental Dynamics laboratory. The School's research environment was rated highly in REF 2021.

Funding

ComponentDetails
Tuition feesFully covered
Maintenance stipendGBP 21,805 per year (2026/27 rate)
Duration3.5 to 4.5 years
Additional fundingOverseas fieldwork, language training, and research training grants

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
DegreeGood undergraduate degree (typically First or 2:1)
Master'sNot mandatory
NationalityHome and International (up to 30% International)
EnglishIELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 minimum per component
Research proposal2-3 pages required

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Application deadline14 January 2027
Start dateOctober 2027

Application Process

  1. Contact a potential supervisor in the School of Psychology first.
  2. Submit a formal PhD application through the UEA postgraduate research portal.
  3. Include a research proposal of 2-3 pages.

About UEA

The University of East Anglia is a public research university in Norwich, England, known for research in climate science, literature, and the social sciences.

Official Link: Apply on UEA portal

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 14 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 14 January 2027. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
